MESA CORE · V0.8.1

A durable memory engine
with structured evidence.

The V4 published source release introduces canonical provenance, selectable validation, dataset isolation, ordered projections, and versioned REST, SDK, and MCP operations.

MATURITYPublished source release
FINAL MVP CERTIFICATIONIn progress
PRODUCTIONNO-GO

WHAT CHANGED · v0.8.1

Stronger boundaries. Clearer operations.

Scoped retrieval

BM25 statistics and audit queries use authorized tenant/dataset scope. RRF rejects non-finite weights.

Storage ownership

Fenced projection completion, safer dataset repair and consistent Kùzu rollback caches protect canonical ownership.

SDK and operations

Sync/async insertion accepts legal_identity. Mutation polling defaults to two seconds; make health checks the running API.

The unused Core dashboard/showcase was removed. MCP control APIs and operator approval CLI remain. Consolidated guides replace duplicated installation, CLI, troubleshooting and upgrade documents.

Read v0.8.1 release notes →

MEMORY LIFECYCLE

Admission to retrieval,
without hidden writes.

A rejected mutation creates no active SQL, vector, entity, edge, or assertion artifact. Accepted work follows ordered, idempotent lanes.

01SourcesExact source text and version identity
→
02AdmissionAuthorized, dataset-scoped mutation
→
03ValidationDeterministic, single, or dual policy
→
04SQL ledgerCatalog, ownership, assertions, outbox
→
05ProjectionsVector then Graph V2, idempotently
→
06RetrievalVector + BM25 + assertion + graph-path RRF
→
07ClientsREST, sync/async SDK, MCP

SECURITY BOUNDARY

Agents are context.
Tenants are boundaries.

V4 authorization follows principal → tenant → workspace → dataset → agent → server-created session. Roles inherit down the catalog. Purge and rollback require explicit dataset permissions.

Read security policy
PrincipalTenantWorkspaceDatasetAgentSession

RETRIEVAL V2

Four signals.
One bounded result.

Authorized dataset, temporal, jurisdiction, tenant, and agent eligibility are enforced before lane fusion. Higher fused scores are better.

SEMANTIC

Vector

LanceDB assertion projection with embedding provenance.

LEXICAL

BM25

Exact and lexical evidence from the SQL-owned corpus.

RELATIONAL

Assertions

SQLite-authoritative assertion relations and citation-aware scoring.

BOUNDED GRAPH

Graph paths

Kùzu Graph V2 paths reconciled to authorized canonical assertion IDs.

FUSION

True RRF

Each lane votes once per candidate, then a bounded legal reranker may apply.

Storage and retrieval views

The storage overview describes SQL, vector and graph projections. Retrieval uses four lanes: vector, BM25, assertion and bounded graph paths, each reconciled to canonical eligibility.

PHYSICAL STORES

SQLite decides.
Projections follow.

SQLite

Catalog, authorization, mutation/pipeline ledger, ownership, assertions, and ordered outbox.

LanceDB

Idempotent vector projection with embedding identity.

Kuzu

Idempotent Graph V2 projection, not the assertion decision source.

Versioned access
around one lifecycle.
